clue.text: A woman of charm, intelligence and distinction

parts.note: wit is quick intelligence
CH stands for Companion of Honour, a British distinction awarded for service

explanation.surface: A tribute to a woman who is charming, clever and distinguished.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Charm' reads as attractiveness, but the definition means a woman who casts charms, or spells. The CH (Companion of Honour) is a British order.
explanation.definitionFit: A sorceress works spells, and a charm is a spell, so she is literally a woman of charm.

clue.text: Items on it may be debated a long time and amended

definitions.text: Items on it may be debated

parts.note: an age is a very long time

indicators.note: amended means altered, so the letters of the word and are rearranged

explanation.surface: Meeting business that drags on and gets amended.
explanation.walkthrough: 'amended' turns AND into NDA, which follows AGE.
explanation.definitionFit: A meeting's list of business sets out the items that are to be discussed.

clue.text: Upsetting times before unity brings an interval

indicators.note: before places the rearranged times ahead of the next piece
upsetting means knocking over, so the letters of times are thrown into a new order

parts.note: unity is the number one

explanation.surface: Disruptive periods give way to harmony, bringing a break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Upsetting' makes SEMIT from TIMES; 'before' puts it ahead of ONE. 'Interval' is musical, not a pause.
explanation.definitionFit: In music a half step between notes is the smallest interval in Western scales.

clue.text: Row up to a big boat, bow down

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word row is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: a ship is a large boat

explanation.surface: Rowing out to a large vessel and bowing to it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns ROW into WOR, followed by SHIP. 'bow down' is the verb of reverence, not the front of a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: To revere a deity is to bow low before it in adoration.

clue.text: Bed of stones for the incorrigible activists

definitions.meaning: broken brick and rubble laid as a foundation under a road or path
the most committed, unshakeable members of a movement

explanation.definitionFit: Rubble foundation is the builders' term, and the unyielding inner circle of a cause is its committed nucleus.

clue.text: Olympic athlete introduced to the Queen tells of distance run

parts.note: Milo of Croton was a famous wrestler at the ancient Olympic Games
if you are introduced to someone, you have met them
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen

explanation.surface: An Olympian is presented to the monarch and recounts how far he ran.
explanation.walkthrough: Milo of Croton was a champion wrestler of ancient Greece.
explanation.definitionFit: A car's instrument records how many miles a vehicle has travelled.

clue.text: One in a suit, complete with a vest

parts.note: a singlet is a sleeveless vest
complete with here means having a garment on

explanation.surface: A man in a suit who is also wearing a vest under it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suit' is a suit of cards: in bridge a lone card in a suit is so called.
explanation.definitionFit: In card games a lone card held in a suit is so named.

clue.text: Chap in charge is demented

parts.note: a chap is a man

explanation.surface: The man running things has gone mad.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words describe wild, frenzied behaviour of a deranged mind.

clue.text: Game, of course!

parts.note: the game is the one played over a course of holes, and the exclamation adds 'of course' as in naturally

explanation.definitionFit: The sport is played on a links, called a course.

clue.text: Cast one's eyes over neckwear and knickers

parts.note: to scan is to look over quickly
ties are worn round the neck

explanation.surface: Someone eyes up a display of neckties and underwear.
explanation.definitionFit: Brief women's underpants are a skimpy kind of knickers.

clue.text: Man who was a former pupil

definitions.text: Man who was a former pupil

parts.words: Man who was a former pupil
parts.note: a man who once attended a school, and also an elderly man, someone who was once a boy

explanation.definitionFit: An alumnus of a British school is so called by its association.

clue.text: Brown backing appeal to Western alliance

indicators.note: backing means the word for brown is read backwards

parts.note: tan is a light brown
O is an exclamation of appeal, as in 'O Lord'

explanation.surface: A politician named Brown supports an appeal to the Western powers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brown' looks like a politician's name; it is the colour TAN, which 'backing' turns to NAT.
explanation.definitionFit: The North Atlantic Treaty Organization is the military pact of Western nations.

clue.text: Florid description of a tributary

definitions.meaning: a phrase describing a plant in bloom, florid meaning flowery
something that flows in, read as one word, as a stream feeding a river does

explanation.definitionFit: Blooming plants are in bloom, and a stream that runs into a bigger river is one that flows in.

clue.text: Mean people find winning hard!

parts.note: close means mean or stingy
a race is a people

explanation.surface: Stingy people struggle to win anything.
explanation.definitionFit: A contest neck and neck is one where victory is hard to secure.

clue.text: One of the two going on foot misses his footing

definitions.text: One of the two going on foot
definitions.meaning: one of a pair of soft indoor shoes
someone who loses footing and slides

explanation.definitionFit: A soft house shoe comes in a pair, and one who loses footing slips.

clue.text: Keep smoking and pant on the road

parts.note: to puff is to pant
a team on the road is playing away from home

explanation.surface: A runner pants along the road while still smoking.
explanation.definitionFit: Drawing on a cigarette continuously means going on with it.

clue.text: He provides for Tom before Rex

parts.note: a tom is a male cat
ere is an old word for before
R stands for Rex, king

explanation.surface: Someone feeds Tom ahead of Rex, two pets.
explanation.walkthrough: Tom and Rex look like pet names; 'before' is ERE, not a position signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A supplier of food at functions provides for guests.

clue.text: No mistake about its being OK

explanation.definitionFit: A fully correct test has every answer right, and acceptable things are fine.

clue.text: Can isn't made of tin

indicators.note: made here means the letters are reworked into something new

explanation.surface: A can is not actually made from tin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made' rearranges the letters of CAN ISNT.
explanation.definitionFit: The chemical adjective derives from Latin stannum, the metal used for plating cans.

clue.text: Make a polite enough request but invite trouble

definitions.meaning: to provoke a bad outcome by one's behaviour

explanation.definitionFit: Requesting something politely and provoking punishment both use the same phrase.

clue.text: A symptom of fever like a hot head

definitions.meaning: spots on the skin that come with fevers like measles
impetuous, acting hastily like a hothead

explanation.definitionFit: Red skin eruptions accompany fevers, and a hasty person acts impetuously.

clue.text: Liberal terrorist organisation making money in Italy

parts.note: the IRA, Irish Republican Army

explanation.surface: A liberal-minded terrorist group raising funds in Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: The currency used in Italy before the euro.

clue.text: What to do if the lights have blown? Rubbish!

definitions.text: What to do if the lights have blown?

explanation.definitionFit: Replacing a blown fuse is fusing again, and trash is waste.

clue.text: Not much chance of it when Peel's up

definitions.text: Not much chance of it when Peel's up

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the letters of Peel's are read from the bottom upwards

explanation.surface: Someone named Peel is up and about, so nobody gets rest.
explanation.walkthrough: John Peel of the hunting song was up early with the hounds.
explanation.definitionFit: Nightly rest is hard to get with a noisy huntsman awake.

clue.text: Chinese gangs give sound advice to trader who wants to boost sales

indicators.note: sound here means the advice is heard spoken rather than spelt

parts.words: advice to trader who wants to boost sales
parts.note: the advice is to try ads, advertisements

explanation.surface: Gangsters counselling a shopkeeper on how to sell more.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound' looks like 'sensible'; it signals the spoken advice TRY ADS.
explanation.definitionFit: Criminal secret societies of Chinese origin are known by this name.

clue.text: Handy implement to fix wood and shape it

parts.note: to nail is to fix wood with nails
to file is to shape wood with a rasp

explanation.surface: A carpenter's tool for fixing and shaping timber.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Handy' means for the hand, and fingernails are the nails being shaped.
explanation.definitionFit: A small abrasive tool used on the hands for shaping fingernails.

clue.text: Throw away the fight

explanation.definitionFit: Discarding something and a scuffle share the same short word.

clue.text: An eve for a tourist

parts.note: a tourist is someone who goes about looking at things, an eye on the sights

explanation.definitionFit: A visitor who tours attractions is a viewer of famous places.
